A: Panel A is a real patient radiograph showing periostitis of the right radial neck, which is explicitly linked to chronic voriconazole use in the caption. B: Panel B is a magnified view providing dimensional measurements of the periosteal lesion shown in A, supporting the diagnosis of voriconazole-induced periostitis.
